summary: The constructor permits only the typed release self-pin equivalence joined to the actual engine host version, constructor/host source and coherent-set source; unrelated closure or ancestry changes still refuse. New enrollment or activation still needs fresh published caller/source-closure, exact project/binding/prefix/reader inputs and a matching acceptance receipt through the guarded route. title: Enrollment self-registration and archived membership require joined runtime acceptance
